final_answer:
The root cause is that `src/checkout.js` evaluated `getExperimentFlag("checkout_button")` before `flagsmith.identify(user.id)`, so the exposure was recorded against an anonymous identity while the `purchase` events were recorded against the identified user, and no conversion could ever be matched to a variant (hence 0 conversions in both arms).

I fixed it by moving `identify()` ahead of the flag evaluation in `src/checkout.js`. I haven't run it or checked the result data. The `flagsmith-experiment-doctor` skill failed to load, so I diagnosed this by hand from `evidence.json` and the code.

Results should only start to make sense for users who load the page after the fix ships. Exposures already logged against anonymous identities can't be re-attributed.
